answer: The signal counter is kept in vault and basalt reveals each reset. Someone hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3087 identities would post 3196 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
